description: Pika H3 Flex reference-to-video: generate a video guided by reference images, videos and audio.

prompt.description: What happens in the video. Cite references in order as @Image1, @Image2, @Video1, @Audio1. Describe shots, camera, lighting and sound.
examples: @Image1 walks through the rainy street from @Video1, wearing the jacket in @Image2. The voice from @Audio1 says 'we made it'. Sound: rain, footsteps, no music.
prompt.title: Prompt

reference_images.description: Up to 9 reference images (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 50 MiB each, aspect between 1:4 and 4:1). Cite as @Image1..@Image9.
reference_images.title: Reference Images

reference_videos.description: Up to 3 reference videos, 2-15s each and 15s combined. Input video seconds are billed at the output rate. Cite as @Video1..@Video3.
reference_videos.title: Reference Videos

reference_audios.description: Up to 3 reference audio clips, 2-15s each and 15s combined. Free. Cite as @Audio1..@Audio3.
reference_audios.title: Reference Audios

duration.description: Video length in whole seconds, 3 to 15. Billed per output second.
duration.title: Duration

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. auto follows the prompt and reference video.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

resolution.description: 480p and 768p are native. 1080p, 2k and 4k generate at 768p and upscale once, keeping audio and frame rate.
resolution.title: Resolution

rewrite.description: Let Pika expand the prompt before generation. Turn off to use the prompt verbatim.
rewrite.title: Rewrite

audio_stems.description: Also return the soundtrack split into Dialogue, Music and Effect WAV stems. Billed per stem second on top of the video.
audio_stems.title: Audio Stems

stems_channel_mode.description: Audio stems only. mono downmixes before separation; stereo keeps both channels.
stems_channel_mode.title: Stems Channel Mode

title: AppInput
